description: From bowhunters and fishermen to tactical enthusiasts and outdoor adventurers, the Fred Bear Camo Spec Ops Tactical Fleece Jacket is designed to keep you warm and comfortable while out in the wilderness. Crafted with heavyweight fleece fabric and warm tricot lining, these hunting jackets provide unbeatable warmth and comfort. The full-length zipper closure and internal zipper flap shield against the wind and cold. These fleece bowhunter jackets feature a mandarin collar for additional coverage and protection against the elements. Two Iconic Brands Unite: In collaboration with Bear Archery, the revered Fred Bear camouflage pattern comes to life through Rothco’s legendary outdoor apparel and gear, including our Spec Ops Tactical Fleece Jacket. Each item in the Fred Bear Camouflage collection has been crafted using the iconic Fred Bear camo pattern. Storage Pockets: The cold weather hunting jacket comes equipped with 5 tactical zipper pockets: 2 shoulder pockets, 1 chest pocket, and 2 front slash pockets provide additional storage space for hunting essentials and outdoor supplies. On the Hunt: The tactical hunting coat features foldout cuffs with thumbholes that preserve heat, maintain range of motion, and prevent sleeve ride-up while aiming your bow. The drawing waist provides a comfortable and adjustable fit, ideal for hunting trips and outdoor adventures. Utility at the Forefront: These warm fleece jackets feature reinforced camouflage shoulder and forearm yokes, enhancing the hunter jacket’s durability and performance while out in the great outdoors. In addition, the 2 shoulder loop fields allow you to easily wear patches.
